name: system
description: The cloud model (system_fmm_*: an API key, or a ChatGPT plan with system_fmm_chatgpt), download links for files (system_share_file), and asking the person for a step you cannot do (system_ask_human). The web address and certificates are mcp/web; disks, network and packages are bash.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|use grok via openrouter with key sk-or-... -> system_fmm_configure(provider='openrouter', api_key='sk-or-...', model='x-ai/grok-4.6')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|here is my deepseek key sk-... -> system_fmm_configure(api_key='sk-...')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|use my chatgpt plus subscription -> system_fmm_chatgpt()

root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|log in to chatgpt, I want gpt-5 -> system_fmm_chatgpt(model='gpt-5'); on system|fmm: chrome_new_page(url='http://127.0.0.1:1455/'); say: switch to Chrome and press Login with ChatGPT
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|the new model does not work, go back to the previous one -> system_fmm_back()
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|the browser is stuck on a captcha -> system_ask_human(title='solve captcha', message='finish it on the screen, then press Done')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send me the pdf you wrote -> system_share_file(path='out/report.pdf')
